markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Natalie Harp leaves (or announces she will leave) as Special Assistant and Executive Assistant to the President before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Natalie Harp holds both of these titles at the same time. She counts as having left only if she ceases to hold all White House staff positions. Moving to a different title or role inside the White House does not count.

This market resolves on a departure announced by Natalie Harp or by the White House, or on a listed source agency reporting that such an announcement has been made or confirmed. Reporting that she is expected to leave, sourced only to unnamed officials and not confirmed by Harp or the White House, does not resolve this market.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure and the natural expiration of a term.

Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions or recusals do not constitute leaving unless she formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If she vacates the role and later re-occupies it, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

If she leaves the role due to death, all contracts on her may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If a U.S. state has banned, suspended or paused law enforcement use of Flock Safety or other automated licence plate reader cameras after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The action must be taken by a state, on or after August 21, 2026, and be reported before Jan 1, 2027.

A qualifying action is enacted legislation, an executive order, a court order applying statewide, or a binding directive from a state official or agency with statewide authority, that prohibits, suspends or pauses the installation or operation of Flock Safety or other automated licence plate reader cameras by law enforcement.

These count:

A statewide ban or moratorium on new law enforcement ALPR installations
A statewide order pausing or suspending operation of cameras already installed
A binding directive from a state official with statewide authority, even where it reaches state agencies such as the state police in the first instance
A measure with a delayed effective date, so long as the action itself is taken in the window

These do NOT count:

Action by a city, county, school district or any other political subdivision rather than the state
Conditions on use rather than a prohibition, suspension or pause, including purpose limits, data retention limits, warrant requirements, audit requirements and restrictions on data sharing
A non-binding request, recommendation or urging that a locality is free to disregard
A review, study or task force that has not itself imposed a ban, suspension or pause
A law enforcement agency's own decision to stop using cameras where the state has not required it
Anything that happened before August 21, 2026

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
markets.title: Will it be reported by a Source Agency that a U.S. state has banned, suspended or paused law enforcement use of Flock Safety or other automated licence plate reader cameras before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the Knesset approves a new government in a vote of confidence before Jan 20, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The President tasking a candidate with forming a government, any extension of that mandate, a signed coalition agreement, an announced agreement in principle between parties, and the continued operation of the outgoing caretaker government do NOT qualify. Neither does the swearing-in of individual ministers before the Knesset has voted.

For purposes of this market, a qualifying agreement or announcement must concern the Knesset's approval of a new government in a vote of confidence. Qualifying events include:

Parliamentary approval with binding effect
A formal commitment by the head of state or government with constitutional authority
An official statement by an authorized minister
An official government press release
A formal declaration during official government proceedings

Announcements with a specified future implementation date, phased implementation announcements, and coalition or multi-party agreements also qualify where they constitute an agreement or announcement of the specified action.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions, negotiations, or expressions of interest without commitment
Conditional agreements contingent on specified circumstances
Statements by opposition parties or unauthorized representatives
Leaked documents or unofficial reports not confirmed by government sources
Proposals or draft legislation without formal approval or adoption
Retraction or reversal of a previously announced commitment

Where the statutory mandate periods expire without a qualifying agreement or announcement having occurred, every market resolves to NO, including where that triggers a fresh election.
markets.title: Will Israel agree to or announce a Knesset vote of confidence in a new government before Jan 20, 2027?
